display_name: Downtown back-alley meeting spot (City Center, Songbird's pickup)
why: This is a narrow downtown back alley off a City Center street: a dumpster, stacked crates and a trash barrel form a squatted sleeping spot, and vanilla uses it as the point where V meets Songbird and gets into her stolen spy van before the drive to the spaceport. The alley shell and its decoration are world-streamed, so in normal play the place stands intact but empty: the people live only in the quest-design prefab #q306_pr_somi_meeting_point, which no kept phase loads. This proposal loads that prefab and puts back the alley's one non-quest occupant, the homeless sleeper (#q306_com_meeting_spot hobo/sleeping, a sit-on-the-ground smoking pose), leaving out Songbird, her van, the Reed meeting props, the spaceport route and the post-ending recording. It proposes no variant toggles because every variant at the venue (song_trash, var_spawn_block) is already disabled by default.

open_questions: Check the alley has its sleeper. Walk into the back alley off the City Center street and confirm one homeless man sits on the ground smoking by the dumpster at about (-2325, 300, 12); report if the alley is empty or if he is lying stretched out like a body.
Check the alley has no meeting-scene leftovers. There should be no stolen spy van parked in the alley, no Songbird trash pile, no activity-log shard on the ground, and no tracer or objective markers.
Check the alley is open on foot. Walk in from the street side and confirm no gate, shutter, door or invisible barrier stops you; the venue drives no door, so access must be plain walking.

Check the neighbouring street is alive. Vanilla switches the whole #ce_cct_dtn_113_com crowd off for the meeting scene, which suggests it is normally on; confirm the nearby building and street crowd is present and the alley does not feel cut off.
Check the anchor fires. Approach the alley past the ce_cct_dtn_10 access point and confirm the venue's _prox breadcrumb flips in red4ext/logs/neonascendancy-*.log.

communities.why: The alley's only non-quest occupant. sleeping puts him on base\workspots\common\ground\generic__sit_ground_cigarette__smoke__01 at (-2325.47, 300.19, 12.13), sitting on the ground by the dumpster smoking: exactly the bum-at-his-spot look the place has before V arrives, and vanilla's own activation for the meeting beat. The other phase, dead, is the body-lying workspot (generic__lie_ground_lean_right__dead__01) that q306_01_reed uses for the Reed beat; it reads as a corpse pose and is not chosen.

proximity_wait.why: The venue drives no device of its own (input.json devices is empty) and has no doors, gates or terminals: the alley is open to the street. This is the nearest real device entity from anchor_candidates, a worldDeviceNode hackable access point at (-2327.88, 276.69, 12.82), 23.6 m from the hobo spot, in the same exterior sector exterior_-37_4_0_0 that streams the alley. A distance pause on it resolves where the person stands and gives the tour a _prox breadcrumb; with one community re-issued it is the natural wait target.
